about_short_description.short_description: Justo helps restaurants in Latin America to take online orders directly from their customers and increase their margins.

product.name: Punto de Venta (Point of Sale)
product.description: Software for restaurants to manage daily operations including order taking, inventory control, and table management from any device.

product.name: E-commerce
product.description: A customizable online store platform for restaurants to sell products directly to customers with integrated payment and order tracking.

product.name: Commander
product.description: A system to centralize and manage orders received via phone or social media, integrating them into a single sales and delivery workflow.

product.name: Terminal de Pago (Payment Terminal)
product.description: A payment terminal device for restaurants to process multiple types of card payments quickly and securely, integrated with Justo's ecosystem.

product.name: Reserva (Reservation System)
product.description: A customizable reservation management system that integrates with the point of sale and supports multiple booking channels with automated confirmations.

product.name: Logística (Logistics)
product.description: A delivery management system that integrates with e-commerce platforms to control and track order deliveries with real-time monitoring and API connectivity.
